newsitem.title: TURKEY: Gun factory stray bullet kills worker.
newsitem.headline: Gun factory stray bullet kills worker.

text.p: An Ankara gun factory worker was shot dead on Tuesday when a gun went off as the factory manager was showing a customer how to use it, state-run Anatolian news agency said.

Hulusi Basceri, manager of the Sarsilmaz gun factory was asked how to use the "13+1 Sarsilmaz" gun. As he demonstrated the weapon, the gun went off hitting 40-year-old worker Omer Yilmaz, who died immediately, the agency said.
Security officials said the incident was being investigated.
